newsitem.title: CHINA: Shun Shing shares rise on earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: Shun Shing shares rise on earnings hopes.

text.p: Shares of Shun Shing Holdings Ltd, to be renamed COSCO International Holdings Ltd, rose on Thursday on hopes of a strong earnings outlook after a possible asset injection by its China-backed parent, brokers said.

"Anticipation of injection of good quality assets into the company by its parent in future has fuelled hopes of brighter earnings prospects, especially as it is seen to be another flagship company of its parent," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.
Shun Shing shares were HK$0.40 higher at HK$9.05 in afternoon trade after hitting an intraday high of HK$9.20. Volume was 8.28 million shares worth HK$74.55 million.

The company said on Wednesday it would be similar to COSCO Pacific Ltd as one of the listed flagships of COSCO (H.K.) Group Ltd, adding it would focus on property development, infrastructure and construction.

Last month, the company said it would buy assets from its parent, including property and hotel redevelopment projects in Hong Kong and China, a coal-fired power plant, a hydro-electric power plant, a toll highway and a toll bridge.
Parent COSCO (H.K.) is the investment arm of China's state-owned China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co.
